# KaTeX browser assets

Pinned version: 0.18.10 (MIT).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.10.tgz
Official documentation: https://katex.org/docs/browser

These are unmodified release files: `dist/katex.min.js`,
